description: Returns the latest cookie report for one of your CookiePal domains, with each cookie’s category, and says whether it came from a local scan. When a start_scan crawl is still running, reports that instead of an old report. The result reports what was found. It does not assess whether a site, page or banner complies with any law, so it is never a verdict of compliant or non-compliant.

domainId.description: Which domain to report on. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

name: get_scan_report
title: Get the latest cookie scan report
